description: Kestrel lowers its content clinic starting price
reference_notes: A good plan avoids a race to the bottom and differentiates on outcome and craft; a monitoring option is acceptable if justified.

description: Brightlane offers a limited-time content sprint
reference_notes: A good plan answers the time-limited offer with Marketing Eye's own value story or a considered counter-offer, not an automatic discount.

description: Kestrel includes a strategy clinic with new retainers
